It is to men such as Tom that we owe so much for the work they did during the formative years when we were making our way and buying our HQ. Eric Hall We send our condolences to Tom's widow Rose, and to Mavis, Eric and all of Tom's family.

By coincidence husband, Eric, managed the same position in his first ever race, the Belgrave Open back in 1948. Mavis finished strongly attempting to catch her 9 year old grand daughter Brittany who was also entered for the Club.

Thanks also to Eric and Mavis Hall for their support and Richard Hearn for timekeeping and hurdle carrying. Faced with only one athlete per event we had assumed it would be quite easy to pull together a full team, but injuries, illnesses and other commitments put paid to that dream!

Well, there are those that know – but when someone at Committee questioned how many of our number actually live within a stone throw of Belgrave Hall, Eric Hall went home and spent a fruitful hour or so going through our membership list.
